name: STL Networks Limited

verdict_notes: revenue fell more than 5% QoQ (seasonally adjusted)
revenue growth under 15% YoY without 30%+ profit growth

annual_report.business: STL Networks Limited builds and manages digital infrastructure including data centers, fibre networks, and managed operations for AI workloads, broadband connectivity, and cloud adoption.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company anticipates a measurable increase in productivity and profitability over the forthcoming financial year, driven by strategic initiatives focused on service innovation, sector diversification, and operational excellence.

Expansion into High-Growth Service Areas: Proactive entry into emerging technology domains such as AI-led Data Center transformation, cloud migration services, and network modernization for 5G/FTTH is expected to contribute to increase in service revenue from these segments in FY27, as compared to FY26.

New Revenue Stream: Developing specialized, value-added service offerings tailored for data centre, BFSI, energy & renewables, defence, manufacturing and telecom clients, including automation-driven service delivery models and analytics-based infrastructure management, projected to enhance average revenue per engagement.

Operational Efficiency and Productivity Gains: Through deployment of AI/ML tools, process automation, and centralized delivery models, the company expects to realize increase in productivity, measured by billable hours per FTE and project delivery turnaround times.
guidance_or_targets.metric: productivity (billable hours per FTE and project delivery turnaround times)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Customer Retention and Repeat Business: Expected to contribute to revenue growth.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Impairment assessment of carrying value of investment in STL UK Holdco Limited, loans given to STL UK Holdco Limited and Sterlite Technologies UK Ventures Limited, and financial guarantee given to the bank for loan taken by STL UK Holdco Limited. The net worth of STL UK Holdco Limited and Sterlite Technologies UK Ventures Limited is eroded as at March 31, 2026, due to losses incurred.

key_risks: Impairment risk on investments in and loans to subsidiaries (STL UK Holdco Limited and Sterlite Technologies UK Ventures Limited) due to eroded net worth
